cohort: The study included 324 nulliparous women of advanced maternal age with singleton pregnancies, comprising 128 IVF cases and 196 natural conception cases from the Second Nanning People's Hospital.
finding: The IVF group exhibited a higher incidence of oligohydramnios and a lower incidence of low birth weight compared to the natural conception group, while other pregnancy outcomes were comparable.
mod_finding: No significant difference was found in the mode of delivery between the IVF and natural conception groups.
